frozen_spec_reconciliation.note: The packet's PRE-SELECTION arm table names neighbour = 5-NY-day trailing sum and control = sham-calendar. The FROZEN selection record (research/control/forex_free_v5_run/selection_freeze.json, 'what was selected and why', produced at selection time, after the proposal) lists the three selected arms as anchor / neighbour (+7d sham-calendar benchmark) / causal control (stale-calendar proximity isolation), and the I1 directive specifies the identical mapping. Authority order (selection freeze supersedes pre-selection arm designation) plus the explicit directive resolved the wiring: neighbour = sham +7d, control = stale c_prev. No open question remained. Consequence disclosed for P-2: the kernel's mechanism_sanity slots (NEIGHBOUR_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_ANCHOR on the neighbour, CONTROL_REPRODUCES_MECHANISM on the control) now bind to sham/stale respectively at scored time, and the packet's preregistered non-reproduction prose (sham-control clause with the 0.5x anchor rule) maps to the neighbour slot -- the packet itself stipulates 'the kernel's mechanism_sanity definition governs where its label differs from this prose'. At I1 these are evaluated only on zeroed placeholders and are labelled not-evidence.

spec_notes: S0 cap implemented in BOTH forms the packet states -- entry instant >= 2025-07-25T00:00:00Z excluded (turnover_and_sample_floor wording) and window exit X falling after the cap excluded (warmup wording); the X-form is the binding one for in-S0 same-day clocks (with same-day availability stamps the entry-form alone can never fire).

Fold force-flat: with daily 16:00-NY bars and 00:00Z kernel boundaries, a boundary-crossing window always has F = the last pre-boundary bar, so crossing windows are refused at entry (fold_boundary_no_entry) or voided when the truncated exit would not span the release (fold_window_voided); the truncated-exit force_flat=true branch is implemented and retained, and the kernel's FOLD_FORCE_FLAT_VIOLATION backstop can never fire on a scheduled trade (regression-tested).

The 4-day next-session fill constraint, session gate, 16:00-NY DST stamps, one-event lag, fold purge semantics, dual book, F1-fixed stress tiers (tier 2.0 primary), break-even bps, once-only publication and dry-run sanitization are the FROZEN V3 kernel's, invoked read-only -- zero kernel files modified.
